questions.question: How many people in APAC have Python at proficiency 4 or higher?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS people FROM people p JOIN person_skills ps USING(person_id) JOIN skills s USING(skill_id) WHERE p.location_region='APAC' AND s.name='Python' AND ps.proficiency>=4

questions.question: Who has Python, Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL all at proficiency 5?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT p.person_id,p.display_name AS person FROM people p WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.name) FROM person_skills ps JOIN skills s USING(skill_id) WHERE ps.person_id=p.person_id AND s.name IN ('Python','Ruby on Rails','PostgreSQL') AND ps.proficiency=5)=3 ORDER BY p.person_id

questions.question: What is the total value in USD of vendor invoices issued in BRL?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(bd.amount_cents)/100.0*(SELECT MAX(rc.fx_rate) FROM rate_cards rc JOIN currencies c USING(currency_id) WHERE c.iso_code='BRL'),2) AS total_usd FROM billing_documents bd JOIN currencies c USING(currency_id) WHERE c.iso_code='BRL'

questions.question: What are the total estimated leaf-task hours for ENG-2026-0001?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(w.est_hours),1) AS leaf_est_hours FROM work_items w JOIN engagements en USING(engagement_id) WHERE en.code='ENG-2026-0001' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM work_items ch WHERE ch.parent_item_id=w.work_item_id)

questions.question: How many hard-booked hours does person ID 348 have across all booking periods?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT person_id,ROUND(SUM(minutes)/60.0,1) AS hard_booked_hours FROM bookings WHERE person_id=348 AND kind='hard' GROUP BY person_id

questions.question: List all active healthcare or pharmaceutical client projects outside the HLS business unit have staffing or key-person risks?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT en.engagement_id,en.code AS engagement,en.summary,k.description AS risk FROM engagements en JOIN business_units bu USING(business_unit_id) JOIN status_lookup s ON s.status_id=en.status_id AND s.domain='project' AND s.code='ACT' JOIN risks k USING(engagement_id) WHERE bu.code<>'HLS' AND (en.summary LIKE '%Healthcare%' OR en.summary LIKE '%Pharmaceutical%') AND (k.description LIKE 'Staffing gap%' OR k.description LIKE 'Key-person dependency%') ORDER BY en.code,k.description
